title: Rain at the Railway
text: The Apprentice and the Keeper came to Vowel Team Harbor on a rainy day. Today a happy lady on the bay waited by the railway with a sail. A basket contained a pumpkin, a ribbon, a lemon and a page. It was a page of the Great Word Book! "Do not complain," said the Keeper. "Display the page, and the lady may sail away."

title: The Daisy Sail
text: Away on the bay, a funny rabbit painted a daisy on a sail. Rain made the daisy drip, and the paint was a funny mess. "We must repaint it, and you may display it," said the Keeper. The rabbit waited, and the Apprentice helped repaint the sail. Today the happy rabbit gave the Apprentice a page of the Great Word Book. Then the rabbit hopped away.

title: Seaweed Beach
text: A lazy seal was sleeping in the seaweed today. The sleepy Apprentice needed the page that was beneath the seal. "Keep creeping, and the page is easy to reach," said the Keeper. The lazy seal woke and gave a happy, squeaky leap. Between the seaweed and the beach lay a page of the Great Word Book.

title: The Street Feast
text: On a sleepy street, a happy lady was eating peaches and beans. The picnic was free, and the benches were green. "Please try a sandwich or a pumpkin," said the Keeper. Between the benches lay a page of the Great Word Book. The happy lady gave the Apprentice the page.

title: The Floating Raincoat
text: At twilight, a bright raincoat was floating on the bay. A mighty, high kite was in the sky. A tiny sailboat was eating toast, oatmeal and pumpkin pie. "Hop on the speedboat, and keep the raincoat in sight," said the Keeper. With delight, the happy Apprentice reached the raincoat. A page of the Great Word Book was in the raincoat.

title: A Fight over Toast
text: At daylight, a mighty pilot and a silly robot were fighting. The prize was a toasted pumpkin sandwich. "Stop fighting, and eat the sandwich on the sailboat," said the Keeper. The pilot and the robot were happy, and the fight was done. A page of the Great Word Book was in the sandwich. The Apprentice might keep it.

title: Balloon to the Moon
text: At noon, a happy blue balloon was zooming to the moon. A page of the Great Word Book was glued to the balloon. A funny camel on the roof was looking at it. "Rescue the page," said the Keeper. The happy Apprentice and the camel were chewing bamboo in the moonlight. Then the camel jumped and took the page away.

title: Noon in the Cookhouse
text: At noon, a funny cook was cooking mushroom stew in a cabin. The Keeper looked at the cookbook. The happy Apprentice looked for the page. A page of the Great Word Book was glued to a balloon. The balloon was in the cabin. A funny camel was chewing bamboo. "Rescue the page," said the happy cook.

title: The Noisy Boy
text: A noisy boy made a seesaw, a jigsaw and a trumpet. A coin was on the dusty deck. A page was in the jigsaw box. The Apprentice pointed. "Avoid the noisy seesaw," said the Keeper. The boy was annoyed, but he gave the page away.

title: The Hawk on the Deck
text: At dawn, the lawn was busy and windy, and many people were yawning. A noisy hawk with a page landed on the dusty deck. "Do not annoy the noisy hawk," said the Keeper. The Apprentice was drawing a happy crab. The hawk looked at the crab, dropped the page, and flew away.

title: The Brown Owl
text: Today, it was cloudy, windy and snowing. A brown owl was howling in the yellow willow. The Apprentice and the Keeper followed the sound downtown. The town was busy and noisy. A rainbow was glowing. The owl dropped a page of the Great Word Book.

title: The Crowded Playhouse
text: Downtown, a crowded playhouse was filled with cows and a clown. The clown was shouting, and the cows were frowning. "Count the cows," said the Keeper. The Apprentice followed the cowboy about the playhouse. A page was in the yellow pillow.

title: The Harbor Breakfast
text: The Keeper made a feast of bread, peaches and oatmeal. Many busy people and a happy lion were eating the feast. A healthy dolphin was ready for a photo. "Instead of jam, try peaches on the toast," said the Keeper. The Apprentice found a page in the bread.

title: The Last Page
text: A giant lion and a royal dolphin made a duet. The Apprentice made a poem about the lion. The Keeper clapped. "You can read each team now," said the Keeper. The final page was a trophy, and the boats were sailing again.
